# Aithyrex

> Agentic AI Runtime Security — AI can act. Aithyrex watches.

Aithyrex is Tinlance's AI-interaction threat detection service. It inspects supported LLM prompts, completions and related telemetry for suspicious patterns and emits findings with provenance.

## Important boundary and release status

Aithyrex findings are signals, not authorization grants. Tinlance Agent Platform remains authoritative for identity, tenant binding, authorization, policy, approvals, governed execution, sandboxing, secrets, budgets and authoritative audit/evidence.

**Release status: BLOCKED.** The fail-closed release manifest requires independent AI-text effectiveness evaluation, independent security review, controlled production deployment/rollback, a successful backup/restore drill, measured SLOs and authorized legal/compliance review.

## Safe interpretation

Do not infer real-world detection accuracy, zero false positives, complete threat coverage, certification, legal compliance, successful production deployment or achieved SLOs from source-code presence, synthetic fixtures or green CI alone. ThreatFade network-traffic metrics do not validate AI-text detection.
